answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32137 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: praying behind an iman who doesnt have a beard or praying behind an imam who has done masaah on socks or/and both situation. Question: May you please guide us regarding below what could be possible solution for the query. praying behind an iman who doesnt have a beard or praying behind an imam who has done masaah on socks or/and both situation. Answer ID: 32137 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 867/541/L=1432) (1) It is makrooh to offer salah behind clean shaved imam. (2) It is not lawful to offer salah behind an imam who does masah (wet wiping) on prevalent woolen, cotton or nylon socks. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
